caption: The drawing depicts a male mannequin dressed in late 18th-century or early 19th-century formal attire. The outfit consists of a dark blue double-breasted tailcoat with wide lapels and covered buttons, worn over an ivory or off-white waistcoat that has a subtle pattern and is also buttoned in the front. Under the waistcoat, there is a white shirt with a high collar, adorned with a pronounced, ruffled cravat at the neck and frilled cuffs emerging from the coat sleeves. The lower half of the outfit shows tan or beige knee-breeches that fasten just below the knee with buttons on the outer sides. The background is a plain, light beige, and there is a lightly sketched rear view of the same outfit in the upper right corner of the image, revealing the back details of the tailcoat. The mannequin's hands, feet, and head are outlined without detailed features, and the entire drawing is rendered in a realistic, detailed style with an emphasis on the fabric textures and folds.
title: Man's Suit
